message: In the ground-level cooperative loading workflow (C5), the random individual crate drop-offs have frequent door-opening infiltration problem. To check it I used batch-scaling calculation (the batch infiltration estimate (E15)), recomputing for two daily batches because operations can enforce discipline, Sam. I found 0.12 kilowatt-hour thermal per day for two brief openings, according to American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers Handbook, 2022. I propose two fixed loading windows per day with staged 250 kilogram per day intake and Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC, flexible plastic strip) strip curtain discipline. My position: not ready because thermal sign-off by you is still pending. In the ground-level cooperative loading workflow (C5), the shared reusable crates and wash area have decay spread and upkeep neglect problem. To check it I used field practice review with the cooperative loading workflow sketch (E8) and the 4-day staged fill calculation (E12), Manager. I found daily chlorinated-water washing of vented crates prevents cross-lot rot, according to Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO, United Nations food agency), 2023. I propose external wash slab with chlorinated water plus pay-per-crate cooperative ownership with trained local caretaker. My position: not ready because system autonomy closure by others is still open.
